editorial.blurb: A Chicago institution delivering perfectly balanced classics—the iconic Chicago dog is an engineering marvel of toppings and flavors that absolutely lives up to the hype.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Chicago dog with onion rings and don't miss the cake shake, which reviewers call a 10/10; the fries are fresh-out-of-the-fryer crispy and worth the visit alone.

topDishes.note: perfectly balanced snap, snap, and freshness—the best hot dog reviewers have ever had
a 10/10, the best thing at Portillo's
fresh, crisp outside and fluffy inside, properly seasoned
